sources.desc: Johansson et al. 2005 face choice manipulation
Hall et al. 2010 jam/tea choice experiment
Hall et al. 2013 political attitude study
Official Inspire3 catalog; product descriptions are advertising
Zen12 exact primary offer; Premium specification and displayed 87.99 offer
Conditional coupon and 37 displayed; not universal final price
Public sign-up, no FV-specific affiliate approval
Names/emails/purchased products may be shared with affiliates
2016 systematic review of standardized mindfulness training cognition
Existing free Focus Fieldbook route; not a paid product

claims.claim: People sometimes explain a face they did not choose.
claims.limits: Do not universalize to all decisions

claims.claim: In 2010 field study no more than one-third of manipulated jam/tea trials detected.
claims.limits: Not proof of lasting consumer preference

claims.claim: 2012 survey reported 69 percent missed at least one of two reversals.
claims.limits: Study-specific, not proof values are empty

claims.claim: 2013 political intervention demonstrates malleability in one design.
claims.limits: No claim of sustained election outcomes

claims.claim: Choice blindness and change blindness are distinct mechanisms.
claims.limits: Do not conflate

claims.claim: Choice-blindness experiments prove hypnosis recordings can implant preferences.
claims.limits: No relevant hypnosis intervention

claims.claim: Premium listing specifies 48 MP3s/12 levels.
claims.limits: Verify actual fulfillment before release

claims.claim: Zen12 provides hour-equivalent benefits in 12 minutes.
claims.limits: Independent program-specific evidence not established

claims.claim: Zen12 has proven treatment for stress, anxiety, cognitive function.
claims.limits: Do not publish health benefit claim

claims.claim: Premium seller page displays $87.99 on Nov 4 2026.
claims.limits: Not final checkout

claims.claim: Coupon page displays conditional $37 offer.
claims.limits: Not universal discount or current paid total

claims.claim: One-year refund promised on primary listing.
claims.limits: Actual refund outcome and complete terms unverified

claims.claim: Public Inspire3 affiliate sign-up is FV partner acceptance.
claims.limits: No named approval or approved earning link

claims.claim: Inspire3 can share buyer name/email/product with affiliates.
claims.limits: Require aggregate-only settlement authorization

claims.claim: 2016 and 2021 mindfulness training literature shows mixed attention results.
claims.limits: Not Zen12 test or MP3 proof

claims.claim: FV Focus Fieldbook is existing free opt-in resource.
claims.limits: Do not present as paid offer; verify confirmed leads separately

claims.claim: FTC disclosure should be close to compensated recommendation.
claims.limits: Near CTA, visible without JS

claims.claim: No merchant-confirmed paid conversion or commission proven for campaign.
claims.limits: Require authorized merchant settlement and qualified-session denominator

claims.claim: The optional short film improves paid conversion.
claims.limits: Must compare confirmed paid conversion, same traffic eligibility and channel

claims.claim: Grok assets match corresponding published FV pages.
claims.limits: Need actual published asset IDs/permalinks

claims.claim: There is a sellable rights-cleared FV-owned paid Mind SKU.
claims.limits: Need authenticated Payhip product and fulfillment

claims.claim: Affiliate commission rate is applicable to FV.
claims.limits: Public merchant advertising is not negotiated/approved FV commission

claims.claim: An affiliate outbound click equals a sale.
claims.limits: Source-verified paid order needed
